capabilities: Replace pf2 code blocks with action cost icons
Render icons in Reading view and Live Preview
Show action icons inside Fantasy Statblocks properties rendered as Markdown
disambiguation: Not an icon pack or theming plugin; it only replaces short pf2 code blocks with action cost icons.
extras: The Fantasy Statblocks integration only works when the property is configured to render as Markdown; README also cites the Obsidian TTRPG Community's PF2 Action Icons documentation as inspiration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display Pathfinder 2E action cost icons in note text or statblocks.

relations.evidence: This plugin was strongly inspired in the Dice Roller Plugin, by Javalent.

summary: Renders Pathfinder 2E action cost icons (Action, Double/Triple Action, Free Action, Reaction) from pf2 code blocks in notes.
